body:
Web client of the ledger design (T-239): implement sections 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 of the design of
record. Runs after the colours ticket (T-241) is merged; use its `balanceColor`/`signedMoney`.

* contract.ts: `type` on Expense; expenses.ts: type-aware arithmetic (`balancesFor` with settled,
  `spentTotals`, `entryEffectCents`, keep `settle`); the shared case table extended per section 6
  and the web tests driven from it; the seeded property test.
* ExpenseDialog (segmented Expense|Income|Transfer, per-type labels, transfer From/To, type
  switching rules, validation, blank-title defaults), ExpenseListPage rows and header,
  BalancesPage, OverviewPage net total, list kind naming (Ledger), tab labels (Entries|Balances),
  "Add entry", "Net spent", every user-facing "expense" that now means "entry". "Reimburse"
  creates a Transfer.
* ALL new and changed strings in all nine web catalogs AND the same strings in the nine Android
  strings.xml files (values only and new names; do not rename or delete any existing Android
  resource name, the Android code still uses them; the Android agent follows later and will use
  your new names). The crossClient test pairs by identical English and must stay green, and it
  reads Android's files, so both sides must be edited here with identical translations. Reuse each
  locale's existing vocabulary; use the suggested Ledger/type translations in the design unless
  you can justify better ones in the commit message.
* READMEs: README.md (the list kinds paragraph), web/README.md wherever it describes expense
  lists.
* Tests beyond the arithmetic: component tests for the dialog (each type: renders, labels,
  switching keeps title/date/note/total and follows the switching rules, validation errors,
  saved payload for each type incl. transfer single maps, editing an old entry without a type,
  frozen/voter behaviour unchanged), the rows (badge, sub-line, "+" on income, my-effect colours
  and its absence for zero/not involved), Balances (net line, income line only when present,
  settled figure only when non-zero), Overview card net, Reimburse -> Transfer payload, the
  one-member list cannot pick Transfer. Each new test must fail when its change is reverted
  (mutation-check them).
title: Ledger web: entry types, dialog, rows, balances, Ledger wording, strings
